title_en: Guo Qingwen — production and sale of fake and substandard products
keywords_en: Criminal; Production and sale of counterfeit and shoddy products; Second instance; Intermediate people's court; Jiangsu Province; Natural person; Criminal Law; Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Crimes of Producing and Selling Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods; Determination of unit crime; Application of the principle of lex mitior; Distinction between illegal gains and sales amount; Revision of judgment; Production and sale of counterfeit and shoddy products; Assembling old and discarded equipment; Contract fraud; Principle of lex mitior
full_text_en:
Guo Qingwen — Crime of Producing and Selling Fake and Inferior Products

Defendant: Guo Qingwen, male, 28 years old, a farmer from Jiangdu City, Jiangsu Province, residing in Youqiao Village, Jinxi Town, Jiangdu City. Arrested on September 11, 1997.

The defendant, Guo Qingwen, was charged with the crime of producing and selling fake and inferior products by the People's Procuratorate of Jiangdu City, Jiangsu Province, which initiated a public prosecution before the People's Court of Jiangdu City.

The People's Court of Jiangdu City, through open trial, found the following facts:

In the first half of 1996, without actual production capacity and without registration or permission from the administrative authorities for industry and commerce, the defendant, Guo Qingwen, rented part of the premises in Yudai Village, Yiling Town, Jiangdu City to set up a factory, claiming that he intended to manufacture equipment for producing batteries. On July 15, Guo Qingwen, in the name of the Jiangdu Guangming Battery Factory operated by Yudai Village, entered into a contract for the purchase and sale of R6-type No. 5 battery production equipment with a total contract value of RMB 206,000 with Jurong Dahe Battery Co., Ltd. of Jiangsu Province. Through Wang Benchao, the Secretary of the Party Branch of Yudai Village and the Factory Director of Guangming Battery Factory, he affixed the official seal of Guangming Battery Factory to the contract. Thereafter, the advance payment of RMB 126,000 remitted by Dahe Battery Co., Ltd. to the account of Guangming Battery Factory was withdrawn by Guo Qingwen by forging Wang Benchao's signature. Using approximately RMB 50,000 of this amount, Guo Qingwen purchased discarded R6-type No. 5 battery production equipment from Suzhou Guangming Battery Accessories Factory, Haian County Battery Machinery Factory, Jiangdu No. 3 Chemical Plant, and other entities, and also produced some spare parts himself. After refurbishing and assembling these parts, he sold 14 sets of this equipment to Dahe Battery Co., Ltd. as qualified products. The equipment was appraised by the Jiangdu Technical Supervision Bureau as lacking the necessary usability and being substandard products.

The above facts are confirmed by the confession of the defendant Guo Qingwen, witness testimony, the contract for the purchase and sale of industrial and mineral products, and the appraisal report of the Jiangdu Technical Supervision Bureau, among other evidence.

The People's Court of Jiangdu City held that the defendant, Guo Qingwen, having no capacity to produce complete sets of battery equipment, purchased used and waste products for approximately RMB 50,000, refurbished and assembled them, and sold them to users as qualified products, actually obtaining RMB 126,000. His conduct violated Article 140 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and constituted the crime of producing and selling fake and inferior products. The charges brought by the People's Procuratorate of Jiangdu City were well-founded and should be sustained. Accordingly, on December 22, 1997, the court rendered the following judgment:

The defendant, Guo Qingwen, is guilty of the crime of producing and selling fake and inferior products and is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year and six months, and shall also be fined RMB 126,000.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant, Guo Qingwen, appealed to the Intermediate People's Court of Yangzhou City, Jiangsu Province, on the grounds that "it constituted a unit crime" and that "punishment should be imposed in accordance with the principle of applying the lighter punishment under the old law, applying the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Crimes of Producing and Selling Fake and Inferior Goods (hereinafter referred to as the Decision)."

The Intermediate People's Court of Yangzhou City, after trial, held that the facts found by the original judgment that the appellant, Guo Qingwen, produced and sold fake and inferior products with a sales amount of RMB 126,000 and illegal gains of over RMB 60,000 were clear, the evidence was reliable and sufficient, the legal characterization was correct, and the criminal liability attributed to him was proper. As to Guo Qingwen's ground of appeal that "it constituted a unit crime," upon investigation, Guangming Battery Factory merely affixed its official seal to the contract signed by Guo Qingwen at his request for assistance. The factory had no knowledge of Guo Qingwen's production and sale of fake and inferior products and did not participate in his production and sales activities. Guo Qingwen's production and sale of fake and inferior products were purely his personal conduct. Therefore, the ground of appeal that "it constituted a unit crime" could not be established and was not sustained. As to Guo Qingwen's ground of appeal that his punishment "should be in accordance with the principle of applying the lighter punishment under the old law, applying the Decision," upon examination, Guo Qingwen's criminal conduct occurred before the implementation of the Criminal Law on October 1, 1997. Article 1 of the Decision, adopted on July 2, 1993, provides: "Producers or sellers who adulterate products, mix in impurities, pass off fake products as genuine, inferior products as good quality, or pass off substandard products as standard products, with illegal earnings of not less than RMB 20,000 but less than RMB 100,000, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention, and may also be fined; if the circumstances are minor, administrative penalties may be imposed." Article 12 provides: "Where a fine is imposed in accordance with this Decision, the amount of the fine shall be not less than one time and not more than five times the illegal earnings." Article 140 of the Criminal Law provides: "Producers or sellers who adulterate products, mix in impurities, pass off fake products as genuine, inferior products as good quality, or pass off substandard products as standard products, with sales amounts of not less than RMB 50,000 but less than RMB 200,000, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention, and shall also, or only, be fined not less than 50% but not more than two times the sales amount." Comparing the two, the principal punishment appears to be identical. However, in terms of the amount threshold for criminal liability and the constituent elements, the Criminal Law modifies "illegal earnings of not less than RMB 20,000 but less than RMB 100,000" to "sales amounts of not less than RMB 50,000 but less than RMB 200,000." The term "illegal earnings" under the Decision refers to the amount of profit. The term "sales amounts" under the Criminal Law, regardless of whether the actor makes a profit or incurs a loss, triggers criminal liability as long as the sales amount reaches the standard of not less than RMB 50,000. Moreover, to strengthen the crackdown on the crime of producing and selling fake and inferior products, the Criminal Law deletes the provision of the Decision that "if the circumstances are minor, administrative penalties may be imposed." It can be seen that the Decision is clearly lighter than the Criminal Law. Therefore, in accordance with Article 12 of the Criminal Law, Guo Qingwen's conduct should be punished under Article 1 of the Decision. This ground of appeal by Guo Qingwen is well-founded and should be sustained. Accordingly, the Intermediate People's Court of Yangzhou City, in accordance with Article 189(2) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment:

1. The criminal judgment of the People's Court of Jiangdu City, (1997) Jiang Xing Chu Zi No. 229, is vacated;

2. The appellant, Guo Qingwen, is guilty of the crime of producing and selling fake and inferior products and is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year and a fine of RMB 60,000.
